title: Joyful Mathematics (Textbook of Mathematics for Grade 2) — Grade 2 Mathematics (CBSE / NCERT)

source.title: Joyful Mathematics (Textbook of Mathematics for Grade 2)
source.edition: NCERT reprint 2026-27 assumed (first edition 2023 per my knowledge; not verified)
source.licence: Chapter and section titles as printed (facts); outcomes written by OpenPath in its own words; no textbook text is reproduced.

review.by: OpenPath curriculum inventory (research from official and secondary sources; not an educator review)
review.note: Built from content/learning/syllabus/cbse-g02.json. Each outcome was mapped to competencies by the inventory; outcomes were placed in sections by shared title words. Sources: https://ciet.ncert.gov.in/audio-book/121 https://ciet.ncert.gov.in/audio-book/122 https://edustud.nic.in/edu/Syllabus_2026_27/2/2_math_english_2026_27.pdf https://ncert.nic.in/pdf/publication/otherpublications/tilops101.pdf. Notes: CBSE does not publish its own Classes 1-5 mathematics syllabus; CBSE schools follow the NCERT textbooks. The 2026-27 prescription was confirmed via official government split-up syllabi (Delhi Directorate of Education; KVS where available) and the NCERT reprint 2026-27 label. NCERT's 'Learning Outcomes at the Elementary Stage' (tilops101.pdf) could not be opened (robots-blocked); outcomes are written in my own words from the chapter content and the official DoE/KVS split-up outcomes. Outcomes are not copied from the textbook; questionTypes and difficulty are my judgement.
